description: This Java class implements the ProductOptionValueService interface, providing methods to manage product option values including listing, retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting options within a merchant store context. It interacts with data access objects and other services, utilizing Spring annotations for dependency injection and service designation.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class managing product option values, providing CRUD operations and business logic support for product attribute options within a store context.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all product option values for a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Lists product option values for a store without read-only restrictions, for a given language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a product option value by its ID within the context of a merchant store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves product option values by name within a store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing product option value entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product option value and associated product attributes from the store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product option value based on its code within a store.
